subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: mutual action plan and next steps

Thanks for the time today, Tom — good conversation. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can move to a short proof-of-concept (PoC).

Key pain points you called out:
- Inconsistent latency and cost spikes on your current LLM endpoints during peak traffic (search and support flows).
- Lack of reliable observability to attribute token-level cost to routes and models.
- Need for a private deployment option for PCI-sensitive journeys.

Goals we discussed:
1) Reduce 95th percentile latency for search suggestions to <150ms.
2) Cut per-session inference cost by ~30% through batching + quantization for the first 6 months.
3) Deploy a VPC-private instance for payment-related flows with audit logs and KMS integration.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 1 (May 31): PoC kickoff — scope, success metrics, test data and access.
- Week 2–3 (Jun 7–18): PoC run — integration to one search route, baseline metrics, recommended config.
- Week 4 (Jun 21): PoC review — results, next steps, SOW draft for pilot.

Stakeholders / decision process you mentioned:
- Tom Hargreaves (Product Lead) — executive sponsor; primary decision maker for pilot.
- Priya Sethi (Head of Security) — sign-off on VPC/KMS requirements.
- Procurement (TBD) — will need SOW + standard terms; likely 2–3 week review.

Attachments: I’ve attached a working draft MAP (Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf) and our SOW template for procurement review.

Next steps I propose (action items):
- Tom: confirm target PoC route and provide a short sample dataset + access to a staging endpoint (by Tue 5/25).
- Priya: share any mandatory controls checklist for VPC/KMS (by Wed 5/26).
- Rishi/Monica (cc’d): schedule a 30-min kickoff next week; I’ll propose times.

If that matches your notes, I’ll lock the dates and send calendar invites + the MAP as a living doc we’ll update.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

[Attachment: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf]

From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: mutual action plan and next steps

Appreciate the concise recap, Marissa. That aligns with our notes. A few quick clarifications: 

- PoC route: let’s start with the search-suggestions route (low-risk, high-impact). I’ll send a small dump of anonymized queries and expected responses by EOD Tue (5/25).
- Priya will own the security checklist; I’ve looped her in here.
- Procurement: I’ll introduce you to our procurement lead (Samir) once we have a baseline PoC report — should be a quick review.

A couple of internal timeline constraints to flag:
- We have an all-hands the week of Jun 14–18, so if possible, aim to have PoC results consolidated by Jun 11 so I can present to stakeholders before the all-hands.

Confirming: PoC review on Jun 11 works for us. If that’s agreeable, please move the MAP dates up accordingly.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Product Lead, Search & Recommendations | Acme Corp
Tom.Hargreaves@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-0220

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: mutual action plan and next steps

Perfect, Tom — thanks for the quick response and the timing note. I’ve adjusted the MAP to meet the Jun 11 review target. Updated milestones below (attached updated MAP PDF).

Updated MAP (dates):
- May 25: Receive sample dataset + staging access (Tom)
- May 26: Security checklist from Priya (Priya)
- May 27: Kickoff call (30-min) — integration requirements & success metrics (Marissa, Rishi, Monica, Tom)
- May 28–Jun 4: Integration & baseline collection
- Jun 7–9: Optimization pass — batching/quantization tuning + tracing enabled
- Jun 10: Finalize PoC metrics and prep slides
- Jun 11: PoC review with Acme stakeholders (Tom to present)

Action items recap:
- Tom: send anonymized queries and staging access by 5/25.
- Priya: share the VPC/KMS checklist by 5/26.
- Rishi: I’ll coordinate the kickoff scheduling and own the technical integration during the PoC.
- Monica: will prepare a short baseline report template for the PoC so procurement gets standard metrics.

Attached: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf (updated dates) and Redwood_SOW_Template.docx for procurement to review. I’ll draft a short mutual-signature page for the MAP once you confirm dates.

If everyone is good, I’ll send calendar invites for the kickoff and the Jun 11 review block — proposing May 27th for the kickoff at 10:00am PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
